packageRules.description: Hold the controller image below Python 3.15: ansible-core 2.21 crashes on it (dataclasses._is_type), so the image stops building. #259 already took it to 3.15 once. Lift this once ansible-core supports 3.15.
containerd/Docker pins. Bumping one only reaches existing nodes through `make upgrade`, which drains each node whose runtime moves, so these are never automerged.

customManagers.description: containerd.io / docker-ce / plugin pins in the Dockerfile. Each ENV is annotated with the deb package it tracks. The pins glob over the Docker repo's per-distro suffix ('2.4.2-4~*'), so only the part before '~' is compared and rewritten.
